about: m4v step 0: the frame-rate baseline of the untouched m4u look (commit db91e57, package-6579e0819aee). M4vFrameRateBudget measures EdgeSceneryFrameRate's six views (1280x720, 3 s each) and passes when its total frame time is at most total_frame_ms / 0.9, i.e. at least 90% of the frame rate; over budget it measures again, up to three passes, best per view.
conditions: best_frame_ms: measured inside a full test run (other tests render on the same GPU at the same time, as they do whenever the whole suite runs), so the test compares like with like. alone_best_frame_ms: the same package with nothing else running, best of two passes; frame times are about half, the honest figure for a player.

step0_all_edge_scenery_frame_rate.log: EdgeSceneryFrameRate test log (m4v step 0, full suite on the untouched tree)
